content: bgfx.cmake root CMakeLists.txt exposes BGFX_CMAKE_USER_SCRIPT cache STRING (path to a custom .cmake file), included via include() at top-level scope BEFORE add_subdirectory(cmake/bx|bimg|bgfx) -- the documented escape hatch for injecting add_compile_definitions()/target_compile_definitions() (e.g. BGFX_CONFIG_RENDERER_VULKAN=1) into an ExternalProject_Add-driven build via CMAKE_CACHE_ARGS -DBGFX_CMAKE_USER_SCRIPT:STRING=<path>, without needing add_subdirectory(). Separately: bgfx's cmake/bgfx/bgfx.cmake target_include_directories(bgfx PRIVATE ... /3rdparty/khronos) -- bgfx compiles against ITS OWN bundled Vulkan headers, never find_package(Vulkan). renderer_vk.cpp confirms (grep) bgfx dynamically loads the Vulkan loader at RUNTIME via bx::dlopen('vulkan-1.dll'/'libvulkan.so'/'libvulkan.so.1') + bx::dlsym -- no build-time link to any Vulkan loader at all. This means there is no possible build-time header/link conflict between bgfx.cmake's vendored headers and the project's vendored Vulkan-Headers/Vulkan-Loader; the 'single Vulkan tree' requirement (Success Criterion 3) reduces to a RUNTIME concern only: ensure the project's already-built Vulkan-Loader .so/.dll (or the system loader) is discoverable on the dynamic loader search path when the bgfx smoke-test / SGProcessingManager executable runs.
